header.subtitle: A collaborative space where content, context, and members stay aligned.

context.viewDescription: This surface shows what should influence agents inside the space and how that context is governed.
context.activeDescription: What the agent should care about right now in this space.
context.durableDescription: Stable space context should come from reviewed memories, profiles, docs, and boards instead of raw chat history.

layers.memoriesHint: Reviewed factual and experiential memory for the space.
layers.profilesHint: Compacted role, workflow, and stable preference summaries.
layers.sourcesHint: Docs, boards, threads, and selections that provide provenance.

context.governanceDescription: Shared memory should be promoted through roles, not silently written by every participant.

rules.reviewers: Only reviewers and above should promote accepted memory.
rules.decisions: Constraints and decisions should require explicit review before becoming durable context.
rules.provenance: Every important memory should keep clear provenance to space content.

context.queueEmpty: No candidate memories in this space yet.
context.acceptedEmpty: No accepted memories yet. Start with reviewed constraints, decisions, and workflows.

members.viewDescription: Space membership should decide who can edit content, run agents, and approve memory.
members.currentEmpty: No members in this space yet.
members.roleModelDescription: A shared space needs explicit roles before multi-member context becomes trustworthy.
members.comingSoon: Multi-member membership and approval workflows are the next product layer for Space.

owner.label: Owner
owner.description: Full control over members, providers, policies, and durable context.

admin.label: Admin
admin.description: Manage structure, collaboration policy, and operational settings.

editor.label: Editor
editor.description: Edit docs and boards, run agents, and create candidate context.

reviewer.label: Reviewer
reviewer.description: Review and promote candidate memories, especially decisions and constraints.

viewer.label: Viewer
viewer.description: Read content and context without changing shared state.
